steps.name: Initialize Socratic Dialogue on Bellman-Ford
steps.prompt: Let's explore shortest path algorithms. When does Dijkstra fail and Bellman-Ford succeed?

steps.name: Drill into Negative Weight Cycles Detection
steps.prompt: Explain how the V-th relaxation cycle mathematically detects a reachable negative weight cycle.

steps.name: Mathematical Proof of Edge Relaxation Property
steps.prompt: Prove that after k relaxations, all shortest paths using at most k edges are correctly computed.

steps.name: Time Complexity Tradeoff vs SPFA / Dijkstra
steps.prompt: Compare the worst-case O(V*E) complexity of Bellman-Ford with SPFA and Johnson's Algorithm.

steps.name: Code Implementation Review in Python
steps.prompt: Write a clean Python implementation of Bellman-Ford with 1-based indexing and predecessor tracking.

steps.name: Inject Edge-Case Bug & Solicit AI Guidance
steps.prompt: If my graph is disconnected and has a negative cycle in a component unreachable from source, does it report a negative cycle? How to handle this?

steps.name: Real-World Networking Protocol Extension (RIP)
steps.prompt: How does the Distance Vector Routing protocol in computer networks implement distributed Bellman-Ford?

steps.name: Count-to-Infinity Problem & Split Horizon
steps.prompt: What causes the count-to-infinity problem in RIP, and how do Split Horizon and Poison Reverse resolve it?

steps.name: Request Exam Challenge Question & Self-Test
steps.prompt: Give me an advanced gate/university exam numerical question on Bellman-Ford with a 5-node graph.

steps.name: Synthesize Multi-turn Knowledge Mindmap
steps.prompt: Summarize our entire discussion into a concise revision flashcard with key takeaways and formulas.
